response.sql:
SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only invoices with at least one line item are included, since the requested average is across line items.
